title.narrative: Advice for Small Businesses in Turkmenistan

description.narrative: Under the ¿Advice for Small Businesses in Turkmenistan¿ project, the EBRD will seek to strengthen the competitiveness of SMEs in Turkmenistan by strengthening business management, encouraging innovation and addressing skills gaps through the delivery of business advice and training. With a clearly defined focus on the private sector, the EBRD will seek to link with and reinforce complementary EU-funded activities under the Vocational Education theme.

description.narrative: Number of activities undertaken with TVET institutions

comment.narrative: of activities.Baseline indicative year 2017.
of activities.Number of activities such as trainings and advisory projects undertaken with TVET institutions.Target indicative year 2022.

Based on the results of the Study of the TVET Environment and Infrastructure the EBRD planned to cooperate with the EU Project Support of Education System in Turkmenistan to organise a roud table for local SMEs and representatives of TVET institutions. The event has been postponed and then cancelled due to COVID19 pandemic. The team is planning a series of online events with TVET for autumn 2021.
